title: MemberRepository
description: Keeps each member as a row of the `members` table. `add` refuses a taken email (TL-LEND-INV01), backed by the table's unique key, and saves the new member; `get` loads one by ID, refusing an unknown one. Each returns the member as stored, inside its command handler's transaction.

title: ToolRepository
description: Keeps each tool as a row of the `tools` table, with its damage report as `damage_note` and `damage_reported_at`, both cleared once repaired; a CHECK keeps `condition` to `good` or `needs_repair`. `add` saves a new tool, `get` loads one by ID, refusing an unknown one, `all` loads every tool in ID order, and `save` writes the tool's condition and damage report whole; each returns the tool as stored.

title: LoanRepository
description: Keeps each loan as a row of the `loans` table, with its return as `returned_at`, `return_condition` and `return_note`; CHECKs keep `due_date` a date (YYYY-MM-DD) and `return_condition` to `good` or `needs_repair`, and a partial unique key backs up one active loan per tool. `add` saves a new loan, `get` loads one by ID, refusing an unknown one, `all`, `activeForMember` and `activeForTool` load loans, and `save` writes the loan's return whole; each returns loans as stored.
